program.name: Pilates Power Long
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Strong Pilates: a hard mat session one day, standing work and glutes the next.
program.about: Pilates with the effort turned up. One day is a hard mat session of teasers, leg pulls, can-cans and side planks; the other is standing Pilates, pliés, leg lifts and roll-downs, then glute work on the mat. They alternate. Level II brings harder moves and Level III adds reps.
